kiesza.bio: Calgary-raised singer-songwriter Kiesza is a Canadian dance-pop and electronic artist whose breakout single Hideaway turned her house-influenced songwriting and performance style into an international career.

kinnie starr.bio: Calgary-born multidisciplinary artist Kinnie Starr is a Canadian singer, rapper and songwriter whose work blends hip-hop, spoken word, alternative rock and electronic music with an independent, activist-minded approach.

kreesha turner.bio: Edmonton-born singer-songwriter Kreesha Turner blends R&B, pop, soul, jazz and Caribbean influences, evolving from platinum-selling Canadian pop into a more intimate neo-jazz sound.

ktoe.bio: Toronto producer, rapper and songwriter KTOE combines melodic, hard-hitting hip-hop with a producer's ear developed from making beats from an early age and collaborating across the city's rap scene.

leif vollebekk.bio: Ottawa-born, Montréal-based singer-songwriter Leif Vollebekk makes intimate Canadian indie folk shaped by piano, guitar, violin and unhurried narrative songwriting.

len.bio: Toronto group Len, led by siblings Marc and Sharon Costanzo, mixed alternative rock, pop and hip-hop into an eclectic catalogue best known internationally for the 1999 hit Steal My Sunshine.

les colocs.bio: Montréal band Les Colocs, founded and led by André 'Dédé' Fortin, became a defining Québec group of the 1990s by fusing rock, folk, swing, blues and global musical influences with socially engaged French-language songwriting.

les cowboys fringants.bio: Québec folk-rock group Les Cowboys Fringants grew from Lanaudière beginnings into one of the province's most beloved bands, pairing communal, politically aware songwriting with a deeply rooted francophone identity.

les louanges.bio: Les Louanges is the Québec project of singer-songwriter and producer Vincent Roberge, whose music blends funk, soul, R&B and refined alternative pop with detailed electronic arrangement and sampling.

lou val.bio: Ajax-born, Toronto-rooted singer-songwriter Lou Val makes progressive alternative R&B built around atmospheric production, measured vocals and direct, highly personal writing.

loud.bio: Montréal rapper Loud, born Simon Cliche Trudeau, is a prominent voice in Québec hip-hop whose solo work pairs incisive French-language rap with polished pop-minded production.

love inc..bio: Toronto dance group Love Inc., formed by producers Chris Sheppard and Brad Daymond with vocalist Simone Denny, became a late-1990s Canadian Eurodance staple through hits including Broken Bones and You're a Superstar.

luck mervil.bio: Haitian-Canadian singer-songwriter, actor and producer Luck Mervil has worked across soul, kompa, zouk, Afrobeat, funk, rap, reggae and pop-rock, including a major stage role in Notre-Dame de Paris.

maara.bio: Montréal-born producer, DJ and vocalist Maara makes kinetic club music spanning trance, techno, house, breakbeat and downtempo after first developing her voice in the city's hip-hop scene.
